name: Rent Roll
summary: A landlord desk for flats and shops in Islamabad and Rawalpindi, with a building whose windows light up
about: A nine-page property desk for an owner with four buildings in Islamabad and Rawalpindi: 47 flats, shops, offices and house portions, drawn in frosted glass over the Margalla hills. Each let unit lights a window on a drawn building, overdue rent shows as a pulsing red dot, and the rent calendar stamps every paid day green. Tenants with agreements and renewals, rent in PKR with receipts and reminders, repairs with technicians, expenses, shared utility bills, reports and settings all work.
how: Open a page from the sidebar: Overview, Units, Tenants, Rent, Maintenance, Expenses, Utility bills, Reports or Settings
On the overview, switch property with the photo thumbnails and watch the windows light up; press a window for that unit
Record a payment on the Rent page: its day gets a green stamp and a receipt opens, ready to print or send
Send reminders to tenants who still owe rent, renew agreements from the timeline, or give notice and move a tenant out
Drag repair cards across the board, assign a technician, and mark jobs done so the cost lands in expenses
Split a shared bill equally, by size, by meter or by custom shares, then add it to next month's rent
Press Ctrl+K to find any tenant, unit or receipt; change rent rules or reset the demo data in Settings
